answer_1.quote: Summarizing long-form narratives, such as books, movies, and TV scripts, remains an open challenge in NLP.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate NEXUSSUM using a semantic similarity, length control metrics. • BERTScore (F1) measures semantic similarity beyond n-gram overlap... • ROUGE (1/2/L) scores are reported in Appendix G...

answer_3.quote: We evaluated the factual accuracy using NarrativeFactScore, an LLM-based framework that decomposes summaries into atomic facts and verifies them against the source text. The evaluation is carried out on the MENSA dataset, with GPT4o-mini (OpenAI, 2023) as a reference model.

answer_4.quote: Setup To explore human preference for generated summaries across different narrative styles and genres, we create three different K-Drama summaries... A total of three K-Drama experts participate in the evaluation... They score the summaries on a 5-point Likert scale... across four criteria: • Key Events... • Flow... • Factuality... • Readability...
answer_4.guideline: evaluators scored summaries on a 5-point Likert scale for specified criteria
